assets.title: Trees grown with ez-tree
assets.author: Daniel Greenheck
assets.changes: Generator code from the npm package @dgreenheck/ez-tree 1.1.0, vendored in tools/trees/ez-tree with its licence; its textures, materials, wind shader and trellis were taken out and leaf cards can be oblong. tools/trees/build.mjs grows our own species from its presets and writes the geometry only; the leaf, twig and bark textures are ours (tools/textures/gen.py).

assets.title: Low Poly Car Pack Volume 1 by Designersoup (Beatall, Landyroamer, Toyoyo Highlight, Tristar Racer)
assets.author: Designersoup
assets.changes: the four car bodies, scaled to real sizes, palette texture baked to vertex colours, the body swatch made tintable paint, lamps sorted into head/tail/indicator, the maker's name on the pickup's tailgate removed, wheels replaced by ours, a decimated distance copy, smooth shading and baked ambient occlusion (tools/blender/vehicles.py). Sources are not in the repo (tools/blender/sources/README.md); the page also asks that the models aren't redistributed as standalone assets.
